name: Western Wall
description: A retaining wall of the Temple Mount, a sacred prayer site in Jerusalem’s Old City.

name: Dome of the Rock
description: A golden-domed shrine on the Temple Mount / Haram al-Sharif plaza.

name: Church of the Holy Sepulchre
description: A church complex in the Christian Quarter traditionally linked to crucifixion and burial sites.

name: Masada
description: Herod’s desert fortress plateau above the Dead Sea, reached by cable car or Snake Path.

name: Baháʼí Gardens
description: Terraced gardens cascade down Mount Carmel toward Haifa Bay.

name: Jerusalem Old City
description: Four quarters inside Ottoman walls with markets, holy sites and rampart walks.

name: Dead Sea beaches
description: Hypersaline shores where floatation is easy; use nearby showers after swimming.

name: Tel Aviv beaches
description: Urban Mediterranean beaches with promenades from Jaffa northward.

name: Caesarea Maritima
description: Roman and Crusader ruins on the Mediterranean with a harbour theatre.

name: Makhtesh Ramon
description: A large erosion cirque in the Negev with rim viewpoints.

name: Carmel Market
description: A busy outdoor market for produce, spices and street snacks.

name: Mahane Yehuda Market
description: Jerusalem’s main market of stalls by day and bars by night.

name: Jaffa port eateries
description: Seafood and hummus restaurants around the old Jaffa harbour.

name: Haifa German Colony cafés
description: Cafés along Ben-Gurion Avenue beneath the Baháʼí terraces.

name: Acre (Akko) market
description: Crusader-city souk stalls for hummus, fish and knafeh.

name: Purim in Tel Aviv
description: Costume street celebrations and parties mark the Purim festival.
